_source: CBP ruling N347899 (2 May 2025): condensate pump, every component sourced from China, subassemblies and final assembly in Thailand: CBP held China. In the selection pool; excluded. Thailand plant capabilities beyond assembly are an assumption; no later ruling on a changed setup.

product.name: Condensate pump
product.description: A pump that collects and removes condensate from air conditioning, refrigeration and dehumidification equipment: a plastic tank and enclosure, a float switch, a safety switch, an impeller and a 1/30 horsepower motor.

components.name: tank, tank cover, motor cover and plastic enclosure
float switch, micro-switches, floats, brackets and wiring harness

operations.name: assemble the overflow detection switch, float and tank cover subassemblies
screw the motor mounting plate onto the motor and place the water slinger on the shaft
screw the motor subassembly onto the tank cover, press the fan and impeller onto the motor shaft, weld the volute, connect the wiring, fit the motor cover and feet, test
